deck.title: Reusable PPT Intake Flow
deck.subtitle: From request JSON to reviewed PPTX
deck.purpose: show how a portable intake request drives a deck workflow

sourceMaterials.value: Demonstrate HTML intake -> JSON -> story brief -> slide map -> PPTX -> visual review -> open final PPTX.

storyBriefHints.desiredAction: Adopt the same request JSON across browser, CLI, and agent handoff paths.
storyBriefHints.promise: One portable request reduces repeated clarification and keeps validation expectations explicit.
proofPoints: Schema separates generic public fields from private extension fields.
Density and exact slide-count rules are validated before and after generation.
openGaps: A project-specific renderer still decides the final slide geometry.

style.visualMotif: quiet engineering workflow with clear process lanes
style.chartTableStyle: compact tables and simple process strips

handoff.agentInstruction: Create the story brief, slide map/source freeze, editable PPTX, structural readback, visual review evidence, and final local open step from this intake request.
